name: Gouda Jouji
source: Gouda is initially a student in Class 3-D, the homeroom class of Kouzuki Yuuko, and immediately falls in love with Suzumiya Akane upon first sight. However, due to various events, he is eventually transferred to Class 3-B, the homeroom class of Jinguuji Marimo, and assigned the seat next to Shirogane Takeru.
